dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's our sketchbook — and it was on the head honcho, as expected!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I need to head back to see if there's anything I can salvage. Let's meet at the alchemy stall in Mondstadt later, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Albedo looked like he was in quite a hurry. Guess those who can't appreciate art shouldn't be able to handle it, huh!
